fixtures.observation: NRL.com Casualty Ward updated 14 September lists Angus Crichton (foot) with a return window of Finals Week 2. The same NRL article records that he was ruled out of the qualifying final after 11 games absent. This is stronger timing evidence than a generic unresolved status but is not official team selection or medical clearance.
fixtures.decision_effect: Upgrade Week 2 return possibility to official return-window signal; retain unresolved availability until official team list or direct club clearance. No performance uplift inferred.

fixtures.observation: The same NRL.com Casualty Ward article contains an internal conflict: its narrative says Halasima was ruled out in warm-up with a hamstring injury, while the club casualty list labels Halasima with an ankle injury and a Finals Week 2 return window. Injury site is therefore not treated as resolved by MAYHEM.
fixtures.decision_effect: Preserve availability concern and Finals Week 2 return-window signal, but classify injury location as CONTRADICTED/UNKNOWN until club or later official source resolves hamstring versus ankle. Do not infer mechanism or severity.

audit_integrity: Prior Crichton uncertainty and prior Halasima hamstring reporting remain preserved; newer official return-window information qualifies those states without overwriting contradictory evidence.
